import { useEffect, useState } from "react" import { getOne } from "../../api/ManagerApi" import Table from '@mui/material/Table'; import TableBody from '@mui/material/TableBody'; import TableCell from '@mui/material/TableCell'; import TableContainer from '@mui/material/TableContainer'; import TableHead from '@mui/material/TableHead'; import TableRow from '@mui/material/TableRow'; import Paper from '@mui/material/Paper'; import useCustomMove from "../../hooks/useCustomMove"; const initState = { userId: 0, mID: '', mPW: '', mName: '', mGender: '', mbirthDate: '', mtel: '', mEmail: '', mProfileImage: '', uAdr: '', } function ReadComponent({userId}) { const [manager, setManager] = useState(initState); const {moveToList, moveToModify} = useCustomMove(); useEffect(() => { getOne(userId).then(data => { console.log(data); setManager(data); }) }, [userId]); return( <> userId 이름 성별 ID PW 생년월일 전화번호 이메일 주소 {manager.userId} {manager.mname} {manager.mgender} {manager.mid} {manager.mpw} {manager.mbirthDate} {manager.mtel} {manager.memail} {manager.uadr}
); } const makeDiv = (title, value) =>
{title}
{value}
export default ReadComponent;
